title: Let the bot run without tweaking to measure true viability of making any money
author: cantontrading
selftext:
I've been working on a project to automate trading given AI has made it easily possible (does not mean it will make money though). The biggest lesson learned it to keep it simple and not tweak the bot or configs frequently (aka over fitting) to chase green days. And 30-40% more code changes are required to go from Paper to Live with broker.
